title: Hutt Level 1 animation map: human (all_m.lat) action names the Hutt table lacks, and the existing Hutt .ans each should use
author: Fable, 15 Oct 2026 (staging only; nothing built)

sources.hutt_lat: appearance/lat/hutt.lat, winning copy patch_05.tre (49,242 B, 206 ANIM entries, header appearance/ash/all_b.ash)
sources.human_lat: appearance/lat/all_m.lat as installed in local_planets.tre (MTG whole-file copy, 361,386 B, 904 ANIM entries)
sources.ash: appearance/ash/all_b.ash: the state hierarchy both tables share (root/standing, sitting_chair, sitting_ground, crouched, kneeling, skill, riding, prone, blocking, stand_attention, swimming, knocked_down, incapacitated_*, per-weapon states pistol/rifle/sword_1h/sword_2h/polearm, each with a combat child)
sources.hutt_ans_files: 127 appearance/animation/hutt_*.ans exist in the client (data_animation_00 + patch_05); hutt.lat references 116; the 11 unreferenced ones include hutt_loc_crawl.ans, hutt_idl_stand.ans, hutt_idl_stand_look_forward.ans and the swim get-hits

how_to_build: Start from the patch_05 hutt.lat bytes. Append one FORM ANIM per entry below after the existing 206, inside FORM LATT > FORM 0000 (no count chunk exists; the first child INFO is the ash path and stays).

ANIM = INFO "<action>\0" + one sub-form. PXAT/0000 = INFO "<ans path>\0" + PUNF "<category>\0<category>\0" (categories seen in the Hutt table: emote, yaw, zero_speed, locomotion; the human table also uses transition and action). Never use PPTR (it names a human bone mask).

TSCL/0000 = INFO float32 2.0 + a PXAT child (transitions). SPAT/0000 = INFO byte 0x03 + idle branch + two PXAT locomotion children (walk, run), as in hutt loop_standing; for loop_crouched/loop_prone use idle + hutt_loc_crawl + hutt_loc_crawl. YWAT/DRAT: byte-copy the named Hutt entry and change only the INFO name.

AGAT (loop_skill): copy the first AGAT block of hutt loop_standing (INFO two float32 = min/max seconds, ACTN = int16 count + (name\0 + float32 weight) pairs, FORM LOOP with the base animation), set interval 2.0/4.0 and the six gestures listed.

Re-read the result with tools/swgfmt/trn_iff.py (parse -> build must round-trip; every .ans path must resolve in the client archives) and pack it into local_planets.tre as a whole file, the way MTG's all_m.lat already ships (MTG-merges/shadow-audit.md, WHOLE_FILES).

Verification in the owner's client: a Hutt NPC via /createCreature object/mobile/hutt_male.iff shows the same table; then a player Hutt: /sit, /kneel, /prone, sneak, /dance basic, survey, a vehicle call; no T-pose, no frozen frame.

skipped_rules.force_*, jedi_*, *_jedi_combo_*, add_for: No Hutt Jedi at launch (owner: Hutts are traders and crime lords; Jedi unlock is a later decision). If a Hutt ever gets a lightsaber these map to the sword set.
skipped_rules.sword_attack_mask, unarmed_attack_mask,: Bone masks, not animations: they name human bones. The Hutt table has none and needs none.

DANCE AND MUSIC. loop_skill is the entertainer performance loop; the human table switches on the performance variable (dance_1..32, music_1..6). The Hutt gets ONE branch: an AGAT (ambient-gesture) form, interval 2.0-4.0 s, whose LOOP is hutt_idl_fidget and whose ACTN gestures are sp_02, emt_gesticulate_wildly, emt_laugh_cackle, emt_shrug_hands, emt_wave_2, emt_nod_head_once (weight 200.0 each): the Hutt sways and gesticulates every few seconds. Copy the AGAT layout from the Hutt loop_standing entry (INFO two floats, ACTN count + name/weight pairs, FORM LOOP). Wrong at launch: no rhythm, and a musician Hutt shows no instrument.
